name: modhub
description: Community mods for Claude Code: guards, panes, and commands that run inside Claude Code itself.

plugins.name: circuit-breaker
plugins.description: Stop Claude from retrying the same failing shell command over and over. After N identical failures the next attempt is held, and you choose: stop, or try once more.

plugins.name: copy-last
plugins.description: Copy Claude's last reply, or its last code block, to the clipboard as clean Markdown with /copy, with no terminal indentation or trailing spaces.

plugins.name: ding
plugins.description: Play a sound and post a desktop notification when Claude finishes a turn or needs you to answer a question or a permission prompt.

plugins.name: fence
plugins.description: Limit which paths Claude may edit in a project with one /fence command. Edits outside the fence are refused with a reason Claude can act on.

plugins.name: right-tool
plugins.description: Stop Claude using cat, grep, find, and sed in Bash when the Read, Grep, and Glob tools fit. Each redirected call saves a permission prompt and keeps raw shell output out of context.

plugins.name: show-paths
plugins.description: Put the file path on every Read, Edit, Write, Glob, and Grep row in the transcript, so you never expand a row just to learn which file it touched.

plugins.name: undo-agent
plugins.description: Undo the file edits a subagent made. /rewind restores your own turns, but not a subagent's edits; this snapshots them and puts the files back with one command.
